description: This file defines the 'Language' controller class within the OpenCart admin extension system. It handles listing, installing, and uninstalling language extensions, including dynamic loading of language files, managing extensions, permissions, and autoloading controllers and models related to language extensions.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class managing language extensions including listing, installing, and uninstalling language packs.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the list of language extensions by invoking getList method and setting output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns a view displaying all available language extensions, their status, and control links.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of a language extension, including permission checks, registering autoloaders, and invoking extension-specific install scripts.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Performs uninstallation of a language extension with permission checks and cleanup.
